title: A Pin in the Mat
lines: Tim sat at a mat. Nan sat at it.
A pin is in the mat!
A tin pin! It is at Tim.
Tip the mat, Nan. Tip it!
The pin is in a pan.
Nan sat the pin in a tin.
The tin is at Nan. The pin is in.
Tim and Nan sit at the mat.

questions.listenFor: A pin. Line two says it. If your child is not sure, point at that line and let them read it again rather than telling them.

questions.ask: Where did Nan put the pin so it was out of the way?
questions.listenFor: In a tin. Line six says it. One word is plenty.

questions.ask: Why do you think Nan moved the pin? Tell me what you think.
questions.listenFor: There is no wrong answer. Listen for a reason of their own, such as it could poke someone, or so it does not get lost.
